about: Project-owned contract (T008 A-01). docs/spec/contracts stays unchanged; tools/project_contract.py applies these amendments to its schemas and request bodies, and adds the new operations (operations) and schemas (new_schemas), refusing a path, operationId or schema name the contract already has. Unnamed schemas are the spec's. Consumers (apps/api tests, apps/web/src/api.ts guards) enforce the rule below; a null receipt or qualification never makes a proposal actionable.
changes: 0.2.0: fields no store holds yet become nullable (account, account_snapshot, proposal); snapshot gains ledger_cash (trade-date journal cash, not available cash) and coverage; pages gain the C-02 coverage; the active-proposal rule accepts a null final-check receipt or qualification. 0.3.0: claim and evidence gain coverage (withheld text, invalid citations and limitations are named there); claim material becomes nullable (no store records materiality). 0.4.0: proposal gains coverage (readProposal returns one proposal, so its nulls are named on the item; list items carry it too); ledger_event lot_policy_id becomes nullable (the journal stores a lot-policy name such as economic_average_cost/1, which is not a contract id; it is served in economic_annotations). 0.5.0: the request WatchlistEntry (addWatchlistEntry, updateWatchlistEntry) gains an optional, nullable review_at (RFC 3339 with an offset, normalized to UTC; on update, omitting it keeps the stored value); needs stays server-derived and is refused in requests. If-Match on every route: a stale or malformed value is 412 Precondition Failed and a required but missing one is 428 Precondition Required; this replaces the 409 that the OpenAPI If-Match descriptions name. 0.6.0: experiment gains coverage (readExperiment serves an incomplete or blocked record with its reasons instead of refusing it; list items carry it too); parent_optimizer_version is a string exactly when target is recursive_optimizer and null otherwise, named none:parent_optimizer_version; state gains blocked and insufficient_evidence (insufficient evidence is re-assessable while the plan's one holdout read is unused, checked against the ledger the assessor is given; failed is no longer derived for it). 0.7.0: GET /session (readSession) is documented exactly as T010 serves it; readApprovalClasses (GET /session/approval-classes) serves the caller's three approval classes, advisory only and never a grant: every action re-derives its own checks, no token or receipt is issued and no identity is served. Both are Cache-Control: no-store (the API sends no-store on every response). 0.8.0: the sessionCookie scheme's cookie name is __Host-pi_session (security_schemes; the __Host- prefix makes browsers require Secure and Path=/ and refuse a Domain). listMemberships (GET /memberships) is documented exactly as T010 serves it: any member reads the session tenant's memberships by user id, a C-02 page of at most 200 with an opaque, HMAC-bound cursor that expires after an hour. mutations is the owner-approved allowlist for amended mutating operations; it is empty, so login, logout, step-up and role change stay undocumented until each entry is approved.
rule: A null in an amended field must be named in the response coverage.reasons as unavailable:<field>, unavailable:<id>/<field>, unknown:<field>, none:<field> or none:<id>/<field>. Item coverage reasons are <kind>:<detail>; page reasons are <kind>:<id>/<detail>.

ledger_cash.description: Trade-date journal cash per currency; not available cash.

get.description: Any member (tenant_member or tenant_owner) reads the memberships of the session's tenant, ordered by user_id (T010). The tenant is derived from the session and never served or accepted. The cursor is opaque, bound to tenant, principal, route and sort order by the server key, and expires after an hour; an invalid, foreign or expired cursor is 400 invalid_cursor. Nothing is written except the authentication bookkeeping every authenticated request records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Server-bounded page size; tenant derived from session.

default.description: Typed validation, authorization, conflict, capacity or dependency failure; never a synthetic success. 401 unauthenticated without a valid session; 400 invalid_request or invalid_cursor.

get.description: The session cookie's principal (T010). The tenant is derived from the session and never served. csrf_token is the X-CSRF-Token value for this session's writes. No state changes except the authentication bookkeeping every authenticated request records.

default.description: Typed validation, authorization, conflict, capacity or dependency failure; never a synthetic success. 401 unauthenticated without a valid session.

get.description: Advisory, never a grant: no token, receipt or signature is issued and no operation accepts this response as input. Every action re-derives role, step-up, scope and object checks. Only the caller's own classes; no operator or maintainer identity is served. Nothing is written.

default.description: Typed validation, authorization, conflict, capacity or dependency failure; never a synthetic success. 401 unauthenticated without a valid session.

membershipPage.title: Membership page
membershipPage.description: C-02 page of the session tenant's memberships by user_id. next_cursor is null on the last page. display_name is the user's stored display name (1 to 200 characters). version is the membership's If-Match version.

approval_classes.title: Approval classes
approval_classes.description: Reasons: role_not_assigned (the session role does not carry the class), role_not_served (no role table, assignment or session field exists for the class), self_hosted_release_not_configured (a self-hosted installation holds maintainer_release only when explicitly configured to; no such configuration exists), step_up_required (no step-up within the window), operation_not_served (no operation of the class is served). held true never means an action will succeed.

sensitive_fields.decision: Owner decision 2026-10-21 (csrf_token documented): decision 13, docs/decisions/2026-10-21-owner-decisions.md. The X-CSRF-Token value is served to the logged-in caller by GET /session (no-store); it is useful only with the HttpOnly session cookie (double-submit).
